Healthy.safety: Continue monitoring and maintain field hygiene.
Healthy.notes: Healthy foliage detected. Follow preventive scouting.

Early Blight.safety: Wear gloves, mask, and protective clothing.
Early Blight.notes: Apply at early disease onset and repeat as advised by label.

Late Blight.safety: Avoid spraying before rain and follow local regulations.
Late Blight.notes: Use in rotation with other modes of action to reduce resistance.

Bacterial Spot.safety: Do not spray in hot conditions; use PPE.
Bacterial Spot.notes: Remove infected leaves and sanitize tools.

Leaf Mold.notes: Improve ventilation and reduce humidity where possible.

Septoria Leaf Spot.safety: Wear eye protection and avoid spraying during wind.
Septoria Leaf Spot.notes: Remove infected debris and practice crop rotation.
